g.text: o Open an address, a keyword or a search
O Open in a new tab — One tab for now: tabs come with rs-rich-embed's
f Link hints: follow a link or use a control
H Back — Nothing to go back to.
g t Next tab — One tab for now: tabs come with rs-rich-embed's several
g T Previous tab — One tab for now: tabs come with rs-rich-embed's
n Next match — Find something first.
N Previous match — Find something first.
Enter runs · b binds a key to it on this site · Esc closes
f1 actions · f hints · o open · r reader · q quit
